| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 写 UI 测试（XCUITest）时需要稳定地找到每个 Tab，但 Tab 的标题会随语言变化，下标会随 Tab 增减变化。现在每个 Tab 和 PlusButton 默认都有 `accessibilityIdentifier`，取自 `CYLTabBarItemIdentifier`（未设置时为内容控制器的类名）；也可以在 `tabBarItemsAttributes` 中显式指定 identifier、VoiceOver 朗读的 label 与 hint。经典样式、液态玻璃与扁平样式都支持。 | UI tests (XCUITest) need a stable way to find each tab, but titles change with the language and indexes change when tabs come and go. Every tab and the plus button now have an `accessibilityIdentifier` by default, taken from `CYLTabBarItemIdentifier` (the content view controller's class name when none is set); the identifier, and the label and hint VoiceOver reads, can also be set explicitly in `tabBarItemsAttributes`. Works in the classic style, Liquid Glass and FlatDesign. |

## 用法 / Usage

```objc
NSDictionary *home = @{
    CYLTabBarItemTitle : @"首页",
    CYLTabBarItemImage : @"home_normal",
    CYLTabBarItemIdentifier : @"home",                          // 默认的 accessibilityIdentifier / the default identifier
    CYLTabBarItemAccessibilityHint : @"Shows today's picks",    // 可选 / optional
};
```

```swift
// UI 测试 / UI test
let app = XCUIApplication()
app.launch()
app.tabBars.buttons["home"].tap()
XCTAssertTrue(app.tabBars.buttons["home"].isSelected)
```

## API

| Key | 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|:---|
| （默认 / default） | 每个 Tab 的 `accessibilityIdentifier` 为其 `cyl_tabBarItemIdentifier`；PlusButton 为其 `+tabBarItemIdentifier`（未实现时为类名）。App 自己设置的 identifier 不会被替换。 | Each tab's `accessibilityIdentifier` is its `cyl_tabBarItemIdentifier`; the plus button's is its `+tabBarItemIdentifier` (the class name when not implemented). An identifier the app set itself is never replaced. |
| `CYLTabBarItemAccessibilityIdentifier` | 显式指定 identifier。 | An explicit identifier. |
| `CYLTabBarItemAccessibilityLabel` | VoiceOver 朗读的名称；未设置时朗读标题（与以前一致）。 | What VoiceOver reads; the title when not set (as before). |
| `CYLTabBarItemAccessibilityHint` | VoiceOver 的提示。 | The VoiceOver hint. |

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 经典与液态玻璃：写入该 Tab 的 `UITabBarItem`，由 UIKit 的 Tab 按钮读取。扁平样式：写入扁平 Tab 按钮。每次布局时同步，因此 `-reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes:` 与 `-updateTabBarItemAtIndex:attributes:` 之后同样生效。PlusButton 子控制器对应的系统 Tab（位于 PlusButton 下方）不设置，避免与 PlusButton 重复。 | Classic and Liquid Glass: written on the tab's `UITabBarItem`, which UIKit's tab button reads. FlatDesign: written on the flat tab button. Synced on every layout pass, so it also follows `-reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes:` and `-updateTabBarItemAtIndex:attributes:`. The system tab of the plus child view controller (under the plus button) is skipped, so it does not duplicate the plus button. |

## PlusButton 与系统 Tab 一致 / The plus button behaves like a system tab

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 系统 Tab 按钮自带的几项行为，自定义的 PlusButton 以前都没有，现在默认具备： | System tab buttons have a few behaviors the custom plus button lacked; it now has them by default: |
| **VoiceOver 选中状态**：PlusButton 对应的页面显示时朗读为"已选中"（`UIAccessibilityTraitSelected`）。没有标题时朗读"加号按钮"（已有行为）。 | **VoiceOver selected state**: read as selected while its page is shown (`UIAccessibilityTraitSelected`). Without a title it is read as "plus button" (existing behavior). |
| **iPad 指针悬停**（iOS 13.4+）：使用触控板或鼠标时有与 Tab 相同的悬停效果（`pointerInteractionEnabled`）。 | **iPad pointer hover** (iOS 13.4+): the same hover effect as the tabs with a trackpad or mouse (`pointerInteractionEnabled`). |
| **大内容查看器**（iOS 13+）：开启最大字号时，长按 PlusButton 会在屏幕中央放大显示其标题与图片（`showsLargeContentViewer`）。所在 TabBar 没有对应的 interaction 时自动添加。 | **Large Content Viewer** (iOS 13+): with the largest text sizes, a long press shows its title and image enlarged in the middle of the screen (`showsLargeContentViewer`). The interaction is added to its bar when missing. |

```objc
// 不需要时可以关闭 / Turn them off if you do not want them:
plusButton.pointerInteractionEnabled = NO;
plusButton.showsLargeContentViewer = NO;
```
